title: Casio Unisex 3H Watch LQ-24B-1BDF
description:
An analog watch with the classic look of hour, minute, and seconds hands in a smaller, easy-to-wear size.

The hour and minute hands are colored to match the corresponding index marks, so it’s easy to tell time — making this an ideal first watch.

The band is made with bio-based resin, a material expected to help reduce environmental impact.
features: Approx. battery life: 3 years on SR626SW
